Guidance

What this viewer is (and isn't)
The color math is correct: your CMYK goes through the selected material's profile to real measured color, with its true substrate white. It cannot guarantee the customer's screen or room light — treat it as a calibrated-intent preview and expectation-setter, not a certified contract proof.
Set up D50-ideal viewing
Aim for ~D50 (5000K) neutral: dim room, no colored walls or sun on the monitor, luminance ~80–120 cd/m². If you have a D50 booth, match the screen to the blank fabric in the booth using the white-point slider.
Roadmap
Reflective materials first (this build). Backlit is phase 2 — it needs transmission-based profiling and a lit/unlit preview, so it'll be its own mode. Send more PMMs + product names and each becomes a dropdown entry.
